description: Lista bunurilor materiale eliberate din rezervele de mobilizare, pentru lichidarea consecinţelor inundaţiilor din vara anului 2010 is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataset.gov.md. Lista conţine bunurile care au fost eliberate atît persoanelor care au participat nemijlocit la lichidarea consecinţelor inundaţiilor cît şi persoanelor care au avut de suferit de pe urma acestor calamităţi. Coverage: MD. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License Not Specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
